authority.scope: Private GTK2 cache invalidation regression. No installed theme changes.

environment.palette_fixture: Synthetic RC colors isolate cache/fallback behavior; KDE semantic roles were not tested.
environment.target: Horizontal left stepper, active/pressed state, missing pressed PNG

findings.baseline_reproduction: With scrollbar-stepper-left-pressed.png absent in a private asset copy, R538 receives GTK arrow state=1 at adjustment value=29 but replays the cached left normal cell after full and partial exposure. The left 15x15 cell is byte-identical to its normal-seeded crop (0/225 differing pixels) after transition, 1x1 partial repaint, and full repaint.
findings.candidate_change: R539 scratch adds a direction-specific cache invalidation when loading the requested stepper state asset fails, before existing GTK box/arrow fallback rendering.
findings.candidate_result: R539 does not replay the stale normal cell. The pressed, partial-repaint, and full-repaint left-cell crops each differ from the normal seed by exactly 207/225 pixels and are pixel-identical to one another. Both baseline and candidate active callbacks report state=1/value=29.
findings.verification: verify_r539.py passed after independent parent execution and read-only peer review. It checks crop equality by byte comparison, not alpha-only bounding boxes. Final verifier SHA-256: 2b20e0056b7f5764d52bef0c26098f95a3f96a11294592d8ab7941e4a273266a.

limits: One synthetic horizontal-left missing-pressed-asset transition only; right, up, down, other missing states, and duplicate-direction steppers remain untested.
A 207/225 pixel difference proves the stale normal image is no longer replayed; it does not prove that GTK fallback visually matches Domain/OS VUE.
No new comparison against the project-owned Domain/OS SR10.4/HP VUE 2.01 VM, no KDE semantic palette validation, and no user visual review.
The R539 engine remains a private scratch prototype; no product source, installed theme, app, desktop, or VM was changed.
next: Exercise the same missing-state fallback for the remaining directions in private fixtures; then resume the GTK2 historical comparison using only the project VM after channel coordination is available. Do not integrate based on this single synthetic case.
